Long-term records have no three-game core-watch minimum. Re-evaluation, training, estimated return and clearance are distinct. No inferred recovery or predictive use.

Core watch criteria & status definitions

Core watch: top three in team total points or assists from this regular season’s records received before tipoff, with at least three verified team games and player appearances. A display label, not a fixed core roster or alert rule. Injured players with insufficient samples remain on the injury list.

Only an explicit Out report establishes listed absence. Not starting, no injury listing, roster Active or no minutes yet does not establish availability. An appearance and later Out report are both retained; no postgame absence reason is inferred.

Player stats use this regular season’s appearances recorded before tipoff; unrecorded games are excluded. FG% uses total makes / total attempts. Missing records or no attempts stay unknown. Original injury timestamps still govern freshness; post-tipoff receipts never backfill Preview.
